notes.title: SpiritSphere Release and 40% discount are here!
notes.notes:
After 6 months of gathering feedback and adding content, SpiritSphere has transitioned from early-access to a full release!

To celebrate, the game is 40% off for the coming week.

so, what has changed?

[list]
[*]3 stages -> 7 stages
[*]3 characters -> 7 characters
[*]max 2 players -> max 4 players
[*]4 spheres -> 11 spheres
[*]4 items -> 7 items
[*]Added Squash mode! 
[*]character balancing
[*]lots of bug fixes
[*]much more!
[/list]

With the new influx of players I expect some new bugs will pop up, and I have prepared myself to go into full bug-fixing mode!

Additionally I will also finish up localisation for Chinese, French and Japanese as soon as my translators send me their translations!

Spread the word guys, help me make SpiritSphere a success!

Quack!

notes.title: Patch Notes January 5 2016
notes.notes:
I've been continuing to work on some issues that you guys have been reporting, thanks again! 
The changes from the experimental branch are now live in the default branch, so I've added those down below as well :)

[h1]General Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]The sphere will no longer get stuck in a infinite horizontal bounce
[*]Locked characters, spheres and stages are now visible in the character selection screen blacked out to give an indication of how many things there are left to unlock
[*] Optimized animated tiles, and possible crashes caused by high memory usage when playing the stage for an extended period of time (let me know if you still run into this!)
[*] Fixed a bug where players 2, 3 and 4 could still select a different character and palette after confirming their character
[/list]

[h1]Baphomet[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where baphomet his charged move would not shoot the sphere froward when the control stick is not pointing in a direction.
[/list]

[h1]Kao[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the flute would play twice when using the charged move
[/list]

[h1]Fennel[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased uncharged dash distance
[*] Fixed graphical glitches caused by the dash smoke particles
[/list]

[h1]Taya[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed 4th palette option
[/list]

[h1]Stages[/h1]
[list]
[*]The Volcano stage now spawns a rock once in a while which holds an item.
[*] Fixed a bug in the Squash version of the Volcano stage where the AI would not approach the sphere on his turn.
[*] The arena enemies in the Dungeon stage are removed when a game is complete, clearing up the stage for a rematch.
[/list]

[h1]Items[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the shrink tome would incorrectly scale the sphere when used by Kao
[*] Changed the angles on which the shield would get damaged, making it a bit easier to destroy now
[/list]

[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
[list]
[*]Each multiplayer session now yields 25 coins
[/list]

[h1]Singleplayer[/h1]
[list]
    [*] The singleplayer campaign now has 3 difficulties; easy, normal and hard. The amount of coins scale with the difficulty you've chosen.
    [*] The AI will now use picked up items
   [*]  There is now an indicator on your progress in the campaign
[*] Made several small changes to the AI (let me know if it's better!)
[*] Fixed a bug where the generated stages would not reset when exiting from a match via the pause menu.
[*] Improved AI behavior for squash mode when it's not the AI's turn
[/list]

[h1]Options[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now set the BGM and SFX volume in the options menu
[*] The tutorial now has background music
[/list]

[h1]Spheres[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where some of the newly added spheres would not be unlocked properly
[*] Increased drop rate of some of the rarer spheres, making it a bit easier to collect them all
[*] Fixed a bug where the ghost sphere would make the menu unresponsive
[*] Fixed a bug where the additional spheres created by the double sphere would not be cleared when a point is scored
[/list]

[h1]Localisation[/h1]
Prepared all new content for localisation. I expect to receive translations just before or just after release. Until then some languages are missing translations and no text may appear, sorry!

notes.title: SpiritSphere Mega Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3o6ZtcluMKAXBz0cuY/source.gif[/img]

Development on SpiritSphere has been going well, and instead of releasing multiple small updates I've decided to bundle everything into one mega update!

So what's new?

[H1]Characters[/H1]

[b]Taya[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25081386/4c9fd2c193e99d57c362c240f6ff970147cbed2b.png[/img]

Just like her sister Lin, Taya is an all-around character character. Her standard attack is quite slow, but covers a wide area. She can make turns while dashing, which makes her very agile! And she is the only character with a ranged special attack, the fireball! Charge it up completely to fire a bigger projectile.

[b]Baphomet[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25081386/4c94b1c339e0b5c84fc8846ca2f10e3327f1165a.png[/img]

Baphomet is trying to get his hands on the SpiritSphere to fulfill his evil desires. He uses his cape to reflect the sphere back towards you, and can do so whilst moving! While his movement is quite slow, his dash is very long to compensate. And as a unique ability, he can actually hold the ball whilst charging his special move!

[H1]Stages[/H1]

[b]Ancient Arena[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25081386/fb578ebfe40e059182f11507344d50ff626a008d.png[/img]

For those of you who did not try out the experimental branch; The Ancient Arena is a stage with a unique scoring mechanic. The goals are divided in different sections, score in the red zone for 2 points, and in the orange zone for a single point as usual.

[b]Swamp[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25081386/7e00c2ac675a583ad279873d269eb2c87ec2c3d2.png[/img]

The swamp is quite wide stage, but features 2 barriers on each side of the playing field. Try not to get dizzy as the ball bounces between the barriers!

[b]Church[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25081386/aaa8527a9c9a759b88717f0aa25ec10d5741a2d0.png[/img]

The church is the lair of Baphomet, and is quite an epic scene! The stage is quite straight forward and features no stage hazards or items. Perfect for competitive play!

[H1] 4 player mode[/H1]

You can finally play the game with 4 players in a frantic team-battle now. It can become quite a chaos, but the 4 player mode is the most fun way to play SpiritSphere in my opinion. Be sure to take roles on who guards the goal and who's on the offense!

[H1]Squash mode[/H1]

The Squash Mode is an new game mode with entirely different rules from regular SpiritSphere matches. Players take turn in hitting the sphere against the wall. When the sphere hits the back wall during your turn, or your touch the sphere in your opponents turn you lose a point! 
It's completely different from the regular mode, and once the sphere speeds up matches can become incredibly frantic.

[H1] Items [/H1]

[b]Bombs[/b]

The bombs are a throwable item that explode on landing. It stuns your opponent for quite a long time and creates a perfect opening to score a point.

[b] shrink spell [/b]
When the sphere is under influence of the shrink spell it will shrink whenever it moves towards your opponent and will grow whenever it moves towards you. In short, ease to hit for you, but hard to hit for your opponent!

[H1] Singleplayer [/H1]

While SpiritSphere is primarily a multiplayer game, I've spiced up the singleplayer mode too make it a bit more versatile. 
- Improved stage and opponent randomization
- Added squash matches
- Added a minigame, good to earn coins!

[H1] Spheres [/H1]

I've added a few spheres;
- Coin sphere : A sphere to drops coins every few hits, perfect for farming gold!
- Item Sphere : A sphere that drops items every few hits, things can get very crazy when using this sphere. Perfect for a "party" mode kind of match!
- Fire sphere: The sphere shoots a fireball towards your opponent's side of the field whenever you hit it.
- Potato : The potato speeds up whenever it bounces off the edges of the stage, making it quite unpredictable!

[H1] Tutorial [/H1]

I've noticed that some new players often overlooked techniques like the dash and the charged move, so I've added a small tutorial when you start up the game for the first time. If you want to check out the tutorial again, it's in the options menu!

[H1] Achievements [/H1]
I've added a whole bunch of achievements, and there are now 15 in total. Some achievements are unobtainable if you use cheats, so be careful about that! Clearing your savegame through the options menu should make it possible for you to acquire them again.

[H1]fixes[/H1]

On some setups, the environment would have visible lines between each tile. I'm glad to say I finally managed to fix this!
The UI might still suffer from this issue. But a new update to my development software might fix this soon!


[b]Word on savegames: With all these changes, it's possible for some users that their savegame won't load correctly, resulting in lost progress. Unfortunately there is nothing to be done about this.[/b]

Phew, that should cover all of it. It seems like the game is nearing completion
I hope you'll have fun with all the new features! 


Let me know what you think in the discussions what you think of all the new features!

Quak!

I've noticed that some new players often overlooked techniques like the dash and the charged move, so I've added a small tutorial when you start up the game for the first time. If you want to check out the tutorial again, it's in the options menu!

[H1] Achievements [/H1]
I've added a whole bunch of achievements, and there are now 15 in total. Some achievements are unobtainable if you use cheats, so be careful about that! Clearing your savegame through the options menu should make it possible for you to acquire them again.

[H1]fixes[/H1]

On some setups, the environment would have visible lines between each tile. I'm glad to say I finally managed to fix this!
The UI might still suffer from this issue. But a new update to my development software might fix this soon!


[b]Word on savegames: With all these changes, it's possible for some users that their savegame won't load correctly, resulting in lost progress. Unfortunately there is nothing to be done about this.[/b]

Phew, that should cover all of it. It seems like the game is nearing completion
I hope you'll have fun with all the new features! 


Let me know what you think in the discussions what you think of all the new features!

Quak!

notes.title: Experimental Branch Patch August 22 2016
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3oz8xP5jzMjsqsaFQk/giphy.gif[/img]

Today is Eendhoorn's birthday, it was exactly a year ago that I founded the company, hurray!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/12Tak8S.png[/img]

I wanted to give something to you today, and I've wrapped up most of the work on the Ancient Arena, so I made it playable for you guys! 

I have also updated my development software which brought along a bunch of weird things, so if you encounter anything strange, let me know!


[b]stages[/b]
[list]
[*] The Ancient Arena is now available in both singleplayer and multiplayer mode! The goals are divided in different sections, score in the red zone for 2 points, and in the orange zone for a single point as usual. [point text is not localized correctly and will be fixed on release]

Let me know what you think in the discussions after you've played it! 
[/list]

[b]features[/b]
[list]
[*] When the ball is placed back to a players' side after scoring a point, the player has a few seconds to hit the ball before it will start rolling towards him. This is done to prevent the player from keeping the opponent waiting, and removes the abuse of the respawning grass in the forest stage.
[/list]

[b]gameplay changes[/b]

[b]ozo[/b]
[list]
[*] Ozo's idle animation no longer continues playing when he is charging, to make it a bit easier for the opponent to anticipate his charged attack.


I've been running into a bug with the AI, once I finished that I can probably move this build to the main branch.

[h1]How do I access the Experimental Build?[/h1]
It's quite simpel; In your library, right click SpiritSphere, and select properties.

Then select the "experimental[unstable]" branch, and the game should update automatically.

You can select the default branch at any time to return to the stable version.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25081386/ba1d16875d58724d41f3e8a0794be6ecd3dc4cc1.png[/img]

[b]Quack![/b]

notes.title: Ancient Arena Stage Reveal
notes.notes:
I've been working on a new stage in between the playtesting sessions for bug fixing. It's shaping up nicely, and I thought I'd give you guys a look at what to expect!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25081386/2b4c540515b2b529f45a880f025e9c5308e0c7ad.gif[/img]

The stage is called the Ancient Arena, and it will be a competitive stage with no items or stage hazards.
The goal is divided in different sections, the orange corners yield 1 point per goal, and the red zone yields 2 points per goal!
So you better be extra careful in guarding the center of your goal.

I hope to add the Ancient Arena in the experimental build soon :)

[b]Quak![/b]

notes.title: Play the latest unreleased build in the Experimental Branch
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

First of all, I'd like to thank everyone for the kind words that everyone has given me, it's heartwarming. 
---

Being a solo developer on a local multiplayer is quite hard, since I rarely have someone to test new features with.

That's why I have added a new branch that you guys can access; The [b]Experimental Branch[/b].

This branch contains the latest version of SpiritSphere, with new unreleased features. I could use all the help in the world with play-testing, so whenever you encounter something strange in the Experimental Build, post it in the Discussions under the Experimental category. 

In return, you get to test all these new features that you are not supposed to see yet! There might be a whole lot of bugs though, but that's what we are going to fix together.

[h1]How do I access the Experimental Build?[/h1]
It's quite simpel; In your library, right click SpiritSphere, and select properties.

Then select the "experimental[unstable]" branch, and the game should update automatically.

You can select the default branch at any time to return to the stable version.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25081386/ba1d16875d58724d41f3e8a0794be6ecd3dc4cc1.png[/img]

[h1] Experimental Branch Changes [august 2 2016] [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added numpad controls for player 2 [b][untested][/b]
[*] Inventory and stage items now clear when you select rematch [b][needs playtesting][/b]

[/list]
[list]
[*] Added an option to disable screenshake
[*]Added chinese localisation
[*]Fixed a bug where using the d-pad in the match result screen would scroll all the way down in a single button press
[*]Fixed a bug where it was only possible to exit the singleplayer screen after selecting a character
[*] Added new music for the Sphere Fountain
[/list]

[b]Quack![/b]

notes.title: SpiritSphere Launch! What now?
notes.notes:
SpiritSphere is available now! So what's next?

There is still a lot of content planned for the game, and I want your help to decide what should be added next!

Here is an unordered roadmap for the game, put a comment here or in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/458170/discussions/0/353915309333940048/]this discussion[/url] on what you would like to see added first!

[list]
    [*] additional characters (2 to 3)
    [*] additional stages (2 to 3)
    [*] Squash Mode
    [*] 4 player mode
    [*] additional items
    [*] additional spheres
[/list]

Ofcourse bug fixes have the highest priority, so that will be taken care of first.

Thanks for all the support! :D
